import sys

def solve(arr):
    min_val = min(arr)
    max_val = max(arr)
    result = min_val + (max_val - min_val) // 2
    print(result)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    a = list(map(int, data[1:1+n]))
    solve(a)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
